---
description: "Sync current progress with the project plans"
---

Review the recent code changes, run checks, and synchronize `plan.md`, `plan-elemental_roguelike.md`, and `AGENT_PLAN.md` with `Design.md`. Ensure that the current phase and sub-phase scope are accurately reflected, completed tasks are marked, blockers are documented, and the next item to work on is clearly defined.:
1. Check off completed items `[x]`.
2. Document any blockers, architectural notes, or newly discovered tasks.
3. Suggest the exact next item to work on.
4. Ensure that no work beyond the active phase or sub-phase is included in the current implementation scope.
5. Summarize the verification results, including test coverage and any static analysis findings.
6. update `README.md` or other relevant documentation if necessary to reflect the current state of the project.
7. Do not commit changes automatically; report the files that should be committed and propose a clear commit message after verification.
